summary: Frontend-only verification of Payout Report page and Google Sheet backfill for Euler CRM. All requested flows passed: owner login → dashboard, owner sidebar shows 'Payout Report' (OWNER badge) under MONEY section, /insurance-report renders 4 KPI cards (Total Premium, Expected Payout, Received Payout, Outstanding), bar chart area, and 'By Month' + 'By Insurer' tables with empty-state message when no data. After adding an insurance entry (Report Demo, premium 12000, rate 15) the report showed Total Premium ₹12.0K, Expected ₹1.8K, Outstanding ₹1.8K, with rows populated in both tables. Settings page shows GREEN 'Connected' status with 'connected (read + write)' and Backfill button; clicking backfill produced success toast 'Backfill done — 0 new rows added to the sheet' (idempotent, no crash). Executive login: 'Payout Report' nav item is HIDDEN, direct navigation to /insurance-report redirects to '/', Settings page does NOT show 'User Accounts' card. Cleanup: 'Report Demo' insurance entry deleted successfully (toast: Deleted, 0 entries remaining).

issues: Edit and Delete buttons in the insurance row do not expose data-testid attributes (only row-level testid row-INS... exists). Recommend adding data-testid='delete-insurance-<id>' and 'edit-insurance-<id>' for reliable automation.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid on Edit/Delete icon buttons within the Insurance Payouts row for reliable Playwright targeting.
critical_code_review_comments: Payout Report chart shows 'Unknown' bucket when insurance entry lacks month/insurer metadata — consider defaulting to entry created date and a placeholder insurer to avoid Unknown-only visuals.
React Router v6 future flag warnings (v7_startTransition, v7_relativeSplatPath) appear in console — enable future flags to silence and pre-empt v7 migration.
seed_data_creation: Temporary 'Report Demo' insurance entry created for report verification, then deleted at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 requested UI checks verified: owner login, Payout Report sidebar (owner-only badge), 4 KPI cards + chart + 2 tables, KPI/table population after adding entry, GREEN Connected sheet + backfill toast success, executive gating (hidden nav + route redirect + no User Accounts card), cleanup delete. Delete buttons in Insurance row lack data-testid — used last-button-in-row heuristic which worked.
